method: Independent native-original review, 2x or 3x face/hand/prop crops, full shoulder-elbow-wrist chains traced in original, direct canonical portrait comparison, current lesson and relevant exercise source verification.

checks.anatomyAndContact: Two complete arms rest at chair and notebook, with natural hand silhouettes and correctly occluded thumbs. Multitool lies separately and continuously on the desk.
checks.displayLegibilityAndSource: Three large raw pulses are shown on the engineering rig with no invented measurements or bridge-approval result. The closed notebook supports the epilogue's absence of further writing.
checks.identityExpressionAndStory: Nazari's quiet absorbed gaze, mature face and gray-streaked hair match the current reflective epilogue.
checks.palette: Muted sage, charcoal and aged brass with warm skin and restrained lighting.
checks.perspectiveAndOperator: Readable physical display fronts with consistent text plane and plausible operator orientation.
checks.largeDisplayRule: Essential lesson information is large and clear, using the available scene space rather than a tiny rear console.
